description: A household is preparing for a maintenance weekend and needs to know which tools, spare parts, paint codes, filters, and consumables are already on hand before buying anything new.

user_profile.persona: 38-year-old homeowner who does light repairs but hates duplicate purchases
user_profile.context: Supplies have accumulated over time in several storage areas, and nobody fully remembers what is already available
user_profile.communication_style: Inventory-minded and efficient, likes grouped lists by task and storage location

fact_sheet.fact: The main tool storage is a red 'Steadfast Pro' 5-drawer rolling tool chest located against the west wall of the garage.
All paint and painting supplies are stored on the grey metal shelving unit in the basement's northeast corner.
A 'SortMaster' 24-compartment organizer for small hardware is located on the top shelf of the utility closet.
A 'TitanDrill' model TD-18V cordless drill, serial #TDX8821, is in the top drawer of the Steadfast Pro tool chest.
The TitanDrill TD-18V has two 18-volt lithium-ion batteries, both of which are currently on the charging station and show a full charge.
A 'PrecisionCut' 10-inch miter saw, model PC-M10, is mounted on the workbench in the garage.
A 25-foot 'LockGrip' brand tape measure is magnetically attached to the side of the tool chest in the garage.
A set of 12 'DuraWrench' combination wrenches, ranging from 1/4 inch to 1 inch, is in the second drawer of the tool chest.
There is one half-full gallon of 'EverBrite' interior latex paint, color 'Misty Harbor' (Code: EB7011), on the basement shelf.
A sealed, unopened quart of 'EverBrite' semi-gloss trim paint in 'Pure White' (Code: EB1001) is available.
There are three unused 'ProFinish' 2-inch angled paint brushes in their original packaging in a box labeled 'Brushes'.
A 9-inch paint roller frame and five new 'FluffTex' 3/8-inch nap roller covers are on the second shelf of the basement storage unit.
A blue plastic paint tray with dried paint from the last project is located with the rollers.
There are three new 'ClearFlow' brand 20x25x1 inch furnace filters, MERV rating 8, stored next to the furnace.
The furnace filter was last replaced on April 15th of this year, as noted on the unit's service log.
A brand new 'AquaStream' model AS-200 chrome bathroom faucet is in its box in the cabinet under the laundry room sink.
The 'SortMaster' organizer contains an assortment of 12 rubber O-rings for faucet repairs in compartment C4.
A 10-foot section of 1/2-inch PEX tubing is coiled and hanging from a hook in the garage.
Compartment A1 of the 'SortMaster' organizer holds approximately 200 1-5/8 inch drywall screws.
A 1-pound box of 3-inch galvanized deck screws (approx. 90 screws) is on the garage workbench.
There is a small box containing four 3-inch brass door hinges in the third drawer of the tool chest.
There are two full tubes of 'SealRight' brand white all-purpose acrylic caulk in the garage tool chest's bottom drawer.
An opened but mostly full roll of 'ToughGrip' brand blue painter's tape (1.88-inch width) is on the basement paint shelf.
A multi-pack of 'GritMax' sandpaper containing sheets of 80, 120, and 220 grit is located in the tool chest's third drawer.
A 16-ounce can of 'Lubri-Fast' WD-40 is on the garage workbench, and it feels about 75% full.
The primary task for the weekend is repainting the guest bathroom trim using the 'Pure White' (EB1001) semi-gloss paint.
A secondary task is to replace the dripping faucet in the half-bath with the spare 'AquaStream' AS-200 faucet.
A pack of six 'BrightLife' A19 60W equivalent LED light bulbs is stored in the utility closet.
There are four unused 'SafeGuard' brand GFCI outlets in their original packaging in a box labeled 'Electrical' in the garage.
A 1-gallon container of 'Weed-B-Gone' concentrate is stored in the outdoor shed and is approximately one-third full.

user_needs.description: What 'Pure White' paint do I have for the bathroom trim project, and where is it stored?
What brushes, rollers, and painter's tape do I have for the painting job?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After confirming the existence of the required paint, the user's next logical step is to check for the necessary application tools.

user_needs.description: I need to replace a faucet. What spare faucet do I have and where is it?
What O-rings do I have for faucet repairs and where are they located?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: When preparing for a faucet replacement, checking for small, easily lost parts like O-rings is a common secondary thought.

user_needs.description: What spare PEX tubing do I already have for plumbing repairs, and where is it stored?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the spare faucet for the half-bath job, a direct plumbing follow-up is whether any spare tubing is already on hand for related repair needs.

user_needs.description: How much all-purpose caulk do I have, and where is it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Faucet replacement projects often require caulk for sealing. After confirming the primary part, the user is likely to think about necessary consumables.

user_needs.description: What is the status of my WD-40 can?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After checking on one type of common consumable (caulk), the user may be interested in the status of another (lubricant).

user_needs.description: What drywall and deck screws do I have available?
What cordless drill do I own and what is its battery status?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: The most direct follow-up to inventorying screws is to check on the status of the primary tool used to drive them, the cordless drill.

user_needs.description: What combination wrenches do I have in my tool chest?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After checking the available fasteners, a practical next step is to review other common fastening and assembly tools already in the main tool chest, such as the wrench set.

user_needs.description: What other paint do I have besides the white trim paint?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the user has confirmed all supplies for the immediate painting task, they may want to take the opportunity to get a full inventory of all other paint on hand.

user_needs.description: What's the status of my sandpaper supply?
